channel.title: Comments on: Did she just say the class of 2032?
channel.description: Insights from work, home, and fatherhood and how they all mix together

item.title: By: Tony Mauro
item.dc:creator: Tony Mauro
item.description:
In reply to <a href="/did-she-just-say-the-class-of-2032/#comment-19">Larry Glasser</a>.
Thank you! I hear it takes a village and I am very thankful for everyone that was in mine over the years and hope to tap into all the pods to support the girls.

item.title: By: Larry Glasser
item.dc:creator: Larry Glasser
item.description: This blog brought back a lot of memories of kiddos growing up and starting school. Your words are spot on and so well said. I will enjoy your blog throughout their years. It will be fun to see what they grow up to be. I’m confident you and Katie will give them a loving, caring home for facing the future. Enjoy the Time—it goes by so quickly!
